_comment: Annual wage percentiles by detailed occupation, national, from the BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics survey. THIS SAYS NOTHING ABOUT VISAS ON ITS OWN -- it is the wage distribution for the whole occupation, everyone in it, and exists here to give the H-1B wage-level figures a denominator in dollars. OEWS suppresses some cells ('*') and tops wages out at $239,200 ('#'); both are stored as null rather than guessed. Detailed six-digit SOC rows only, so the totals and major groups are excluded and the rows do not sum to national employment.
source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, national files
